name: Utsugi Mirai
source:
"Miki's Ichiyaramon!"

Produced by Ichiya during his entertainment debut, he is now an active TV program host for children and a CM model. He thinks that if he works hard, he'll be able to stay by Ichiya's side. He thinks he's Ichiya's lover, but everyone around them thinks they have a parent-child relationship.

His love rival is Ruka and they don't get along well. He speaks an incomprehensible language because he is not good at vocalization.

Hobby: Billiards (Being hugged by Ichiya)
Likes: Ichiya, pudding, strawberry milk, rabbits
Dislikes: Carrots, ghosts

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041205190632/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char07.htm]official website[/url]]
